title: Check hotel guests in at lobby kiosks
body:
# Check hotel guests in at lobby kiosks

## Context
Queues at the front desk of the Quayside Hotel ran past twenty minutes on Friday evenings.

## Decision
Guests check in at self-service kiosks in the lobby, and the porters take each guest's bags up to the room as soon as the kiosk prints the room card. Front-desk staff stay on hand for guests who need help at a kiosk.

## Consequences
Friday queues fell to a few minutes. The front desk now closes at midnight.
